ctx.x: Well, I didn't have no preference but bands, you know what I mean?
You have a favorite musician there? I liked, listen, Armstrong playing, you know?

What was he like, you know, his playing, you know what I mean? A lot of people asked me why, you know what I mean, why I don't play that game. And you know what I mean? You know what I mean? Why don't you play that game? Yeah. You know what I mean? You know what I mean? I don't play that game. I said, well, no. I said, you're not supposed to play. You play your own style, you know? So I always liked his playing. Yeah. Always liked his playing.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1964-03-21
items.q: I used to hold bass for Louis.

ctx.x: Stop it Paul, she can't fix it. Okay. Alright. What's your name? My name is Joseph. That's not what everybody calls you. They call me Kid Twat from the Boothwaite.

Well where the Boothwaite come from? I was up in St. Paul, Minnesota. I left there. I came on down there to St. Louis. Where I was then. They used me. I was taken right from my own hometown. And then what they call me then? Kid Twat from the Boothwaite. Why they call me that? Because I was a cigarette tester. Cigarette tester. Where were you born? I was born right here on the next street. I was right there where I came out. In Algiers. Al J is right where I am young now. On the next street I'm on the Homer Street…
